headerDisplay: Expose rpi-procmon monitor health to Apple Home as Contact Sensors.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Display name for this Homebridge platform instance.

endpoint.title: Procmon API Base URL
endpoint.description: Base URL for the procmon API. Example: http://192.168.5.11:9645

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the plugin fetches /status from procmon.

requestTimeoutMs.title: Request Timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for procmon API requests.

exposeOverallSensor.title: Expose Overall Fault Sensor
exposeOverallSensor.description: Create one top-level Contact Sensor for overall procmon health.

exposeDisabledMonitors.title: Expose Disabled Monitors
exposeDisabledMonitors.description: Include monitors that procmon reports as disabled.

hideHealthyMonitors.title: Hide Healthy Monitors
hideHealthyMonitors.description: Initially hide healthy monitors. Once exposed, retain a monitor when it recovers to preserve HomeKit identity and automations.

includeMonitors.title: Include Monitor IDs
includeMonitors.description: Optional allowlist of procmon monitor ids to expose.

excludeMonitors.title: Exclude Monitor IDs
excludeMonitors.description: Optional denylist of procmon monitor ids to hide.
